trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the issue:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that had been healthy in production — in all regions. Verified service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident:** Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the root cause before any redeployment of v2.3.1.
